turns.reply:
Today is all about keeping it simple and stress-free. We are just aiming for a 20-minute walk at an easy, comfortable pace where you could still easily carry on a conversation. 

You don't need any special gear or gym clothes—just put on a comfortable pair of shoes, step out the door, and walk for 10 minutes in one direction, then turn around and walk back.
